answer: A key farm can mint a thousand identities in a minute, but not a thousand different pasts. Make credit accrue only from seals an account actually lived through, so a clone born today has no history to spend and the farmer must feed each one real work for weeks before any of them pays. The echo of an aged account cannot be cloned, only bought with that account's own future. A reef grows one polyp at a time; a lantern lit an hour ago lights less ground than one burning since the season opened.
